_note: Supplement Facts panels read off amway.com product pages. Fetch these before writing any product row: the label often contains the actual argument, and writing from the product name alone produces generic copy. amway.com 403s plain curl, so fetch through the browser tools after navigating to the amway.com origin. The panel sits in an accordion and is not in document.body.innerText, so parse the raw HTML: strip <script>, replace tags with |, then slice from 'Amount Per Serving'.

117085.name: Nutrilite Slimmetry
actives: of which Green Tea Extract (Camellia sinensis, leaf) 50 mg [20 mg EGCG]
117085.other: Greenselect Phytosome (Soy Lecithin, Green Tea Decaffeinated Dry Extract), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Pregelatinized Corn Starch, Stearic Acid, Gum Acacia, Sodium Starch Glycolate, Maltodextrin, Silicon Dioxide, Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Brown Algae Extract, Glycerin, Carnauba Wax
117085.note: The whole product is a bioavailability play. 20mg EGCG is a small fraction of the 200 to 800mg used in ordinary green tea extract trials; the phospholipid complex is what makes the low dose workable, and it also sidesteps the hepatotoxicity signal seen with high-dose extracts.
